page.title: Rebuild
page.lead: A position appears for a few seconds then disappears: place all the pieces from memory on the empty board. {n} exact rebuilds unlock the next level. No effect on your puzzle rating.
page.toUnlock: {played} · {left} more exact rebuild(s) to unlock level {next}.
page.freeHint: Play this level's positions at your own pace, as many as you want.

bubbles.exact: Every piece in its place. Your board memory is improving!
bubbles.close: You're just missing a little: look at the outlined squares.
bubbles.missed: Compare with the position: spot the piece groups before it disappears.

player.memorizeText: Remember each piece and its square: the position is about to disappear.
player.listenText: Keep the position in mind and play the announced moves in your head.
player.rebuildText: Pick a piece, then tap its square. Tap a placed piece to remove it.
player.rebuildAfterText: Rebuild the position after the announced moves: pick a piece, then tap its square.
